result.scope: Re-evaluation of the preserved zero-delay native Icarus gate-level CPU/Ethernet firmware boot with PCIe held link-down. No PCIe traffic, MBIST execution, SDF, analog PHY or fault coverage.

configuration.status: requested configuration; consult RTL, synthesis and gate results

pcie.scope: Packet interface held link-down during real CPU/Ethernet firmware boot; no packet traffic, SDF or serial PHY qualification.

mbist.scope: Observe actual mapped system and Ethernet MBIST busy-to-done handover during boot; no complete memory fault or physical qualification.
